sources.title: cstr/chatterbox-GGUF · Hugging Face | Sweet Tea Studio
sources.snippet: Chatterbox is a full TTS pipeline: character tokenizer → T3 (30-layer Llama AR, 520M) → speech tokens → S3Gen (Conformer encoder + UNet1D CFM denoiser, 10 Euler steps) → HiFTGenerator vocoder (conv chains + Snake activations + iSTFT) → 24 kHz WAV.
